name: k6-typescript-template
description: Opinionated starter for safe, continuous API performance testing with k6.
author: Sergio Cuadros

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:inspect
scripts.test:inspect: k6 inspect src/tests/smoke.ts && k6 inspect -e AUTH_SECRET_NAME=auth-token src/tests/authenticated-smoke.ts && k6 inspect -e BASE_URL=https://example.invalid -e ENVIRONMENT=staging -e ALLOW_LOAD_TEST=true src/tests/average-load.ts && k6 inspect -e BASE_URL=https://example.invalid -e ENVIRONMENT=staging -e ALLOW_LOAD_TEST=true src/tests/stress.ts
